=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml
  Line or code reference: lines 82-86, the Checkout repository step (`actions/checkout@v5` with `token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}` and no `persist-credentials: false`)
  PROBLEM: The checkout persists `GH_PAT` in `.git/config`, granting the worktree Git credential access to this repo and every consumer repo. The job later runs the diagnosis model with `--sandbox danger-full-access` over explicitly untrusted content (issue bodies, comments, workflow logs). The script at intake.sh:398 strips `GH_TOKEN`/`GITHUB_TOKEN`/telegram env vars but does NOT strip `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, which the model inherits.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: A malicious log line or issue comment can instruct the model to read `.git/config` and emit the PAT into the public heal issue body, or use the API key to make unauthorized OpenRouter calls. Even without the API key, the persisted Git credential lets the model push to protected branches or access private consumer data.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 398-405, the codex exec invocation
  PROBLEM: The `env -u` scrubbing removes `GH_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `TG_BOT_SECRET`, `TG_ADMIN_CHAT_ID`, `TG_CHAT_ID` but does NOT remove `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` from the model's environment. The model runs with `--sandbox danger-full-access`, `--ask-for-approval never`, `include_apply_patch_tool=true`, and processes untrusted content (issue bodies, comments, workflow logs).
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: Prompt injection in an untrusted log or comment can cause the model to echo `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` into the diagnosis output, which becomes a public comment on a heal issue, enabling unauthorized OpenRouter spend by anyone who reads it.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 257-259, `gh_retry gh api --paginate "repos/${SELF_REPO}/issues" -F state=all -F labels="${HEAL_LABEL}" -F per_page=100`
  PROBLEM: The command passes `-F` (form fields) without `--method GET`. The `gh api` command defaults to POST when `-F`/`--field` flags are present, so GitHub rejects this as an issue-creation attempt without a title. The `--paginate` flag may not override the POST default.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: Every intake invocation fails at the dedup step with `heal_issue_list_failed`, the script exits 1, the Telegram `ERROR` fires, and no heal issue is ever created. The mock `gh` in the test suite handles this path as GET regardless of method, so the test passes but production fails.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_report.sh
  Line or code reference: line 129, `gh_retry gh api --paginate "repos/${REPO}/issues/${ISSUE_NUMBER}/comments" -F per_page=100`
  PROBLEM: Same `-F` without `--method GET` pattern. This is a read of issue comments; POST to the comments endpoint creates a new comment, which fails.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: The report script fails to collect comments, logs a warning, and continues with an empty comments list. The intake then diagnoses from incomplete evidence.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_report.sh
  Line or code reference: line 142, `gh_api_json_to_file "${RUNS_JSON_FILE}" gh api "repos/${REPO}/actions/runs" -F per_page=100`
  PROBLEM: Same `-F` without `--method GET` pattern on a read of the runs list. No `--paginate` to potentially override; POST to the runs endpoint is definitively wrong.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: The report script cannot collect recent workflow runs to match against the issue title. It continues with an empty runs list, so the payload only carries run references found in comments.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_report.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 99-110, the `importlib` label-check gate
  PROBLEM: `spec.loader.exec_module(module)` can raise ANY exception (syntax error, import error, runtime exception). The shell `if ! python3 ...` treats any non-zero exit as "label not human needed" and silently exits 0 with `skip reason=label_not_human_needed`.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: If `workflow_failure_heal.py` is corrupted or cannot import, every escalation on the repository is silently skipped without a Telegram alert. The reporter exits 0 (green), the issue stays escalated with no heal issue opened.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 445-448, `_branch_exists()` function: `gh_retry gh api "repos/${repo}/branches/${branch}"`
  PROBLEM: The branch name is interpolated directly into the GitHub API URL path without URL encoding. The `validate_payload` function in `workflow_failure_heal.py` accepts branch names matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]{0,199}$`, which permits `/`. A branch like `release/1.0` produces the URL path `repos/owner/repo/branches/release/1.0`, which GitHub interprets as a nested resource and returns 404.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: The existence check returns false, `TARGET_BRANCH` is cleared to empty at line 501, and the heal issue silently targets the default branch instead of the branch where the failure occurred. The plan and implement phases then fix against the wrong base, and the hotfix does not reach the failing branch.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 256-264, dedup/budget only inspects `SELF_REPO` issues
  PROBLEM: The heal issue list is fetched exclusively from `SELF_REPO` (coding-workflows). When `consumer-app-defect` classification opens a heal issue on `SOURCE_REPO` at line 522-523, that issue is never visible to the dedup, lineage, or budget gates. The consumer-side issue is also not counted toward the open-issue or per-day limits.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: Repeated escalations for the same consumer-side defect create new issues on every report instead of being deduplicated or occurrence-commented. The open-issue and per-day budgets do not cap consumer-side issues, so a single consumer bug loop can create unlimited heal issues.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 172 and 196, `gh api "repos/${SOURCE_REPO}/actions/runs/${run_id}/jobs" -F per_page=100`
  PROBLEM: This `gh api` call al
